title: A More Detailed Cockpit for the Q-180
body:
The Quartz County Q-180 utility aircraft now has a more detailed two-seat cockpit. The panel has a classic six-pack of flight instruments, separate engine gauges, an annunciator strip and an illuminated avionics stack. Matching yokes, rudder pedals and a central throttle quadrant fill out the cabin.

The in-engine showcase starts inside the open cabin, then moves through the pilot-side doorway and across the instrument panel, then ends with a staged flight view from the pilot seat over Quartz County. The throttle and flap controls move and the panel shows the changes. During a gentle bank, the yokes and attitude indicator move too.

videos.caption: A look through the open cabin, across the instrument panel and out from the pilot’s seat.
